name: Weaviate
one_liner: Vector database storing objects alongside their vectors.
what_it_is: An open-source, cloud-native vector database that stores both objects and vectors, enabling semantic search at scale, in its own words. Keeping the object with its vector means a result carries its source record rather than an identifier to resolve elsewhere.
why_it_matters: Holding objects and vectors together removes the lookup step that otherwise sits between a search result and something you can show a user, and its schema makes the shape of the corpus explicit rather than implied by whatever was indexed. The cost is another stateful system with its own schema to model and migrate.
suitable_for: Corpora where results must carry their source objects
Teams who want the corpus shape declared as a schema
Deployments already running in a cluster
not_suitable_for: Small projects where a database extension is less to operate
Teams without capacity to model and migrate another schema
Cases where the source records must stay in the system of record
